tweet.text:
Six-packs to a pretty good job.

So...  I'm thinking a good model for a squad would be a set of six-packs (or 4-packs in some cases) that work on independent issues, with a supervisor that designs the interfaces between them, integrates, and runs integration tests.  

Hmmm.
